stemMd:
A student has taken these notes:
- A community garden installed a shared tool shed.
- Members can borrow tools instead of buying them individually.
- The shed opens three afternoons each week.
- Members report meeting neighbors while borrowing tools.

The student wants to emphasize a social benefit rather than a financial one. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The garden installed a shed for its tools.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Members can avoid purchasing some tools individually.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Borrowing from the shared shed gives members opportunities to meet neighbors.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The shed opens three afternoons each week.

explanationMd: The notes distinguish cost savings from social contact. The keyed sentence selects the information relevant to the requested social emphasis.

distractorRationale.b: This emphasizes the financial benefit the goal sets aside.
distractorRationale.d: Opening hours do not state the social benefit.
distractorRationale.a: This identifies the facility without explaining its effect.
